Accept default work and school departure times and durations as simulation assumptions. Find homes to compare.

Both parents commute Monday to Friday, every week. Enrollment and catchment must stay unmodeled: we only want the nearest mapped elementary-school route for Child 1 and middle-school route for Child 2 as explicit assumptions. Confirm all other routines and default times already stated.

limits: The principal video follows one actual saved couple run. The family is a separate illustrative household and run.
Inputs are hypothetical household conditions, not the founder’s actual finances.
Historical transaction references and area bands are not asking prices, available listings or exact unit sizes.
Workplaces near named stations, default schedules, loan terms and maintenance are reviewed simulation assumptions.
School routes use mapped POIs matched to stated levels, not assigned schools or catchment eligibility.
A 30-day window repeats routines under assumptions; it does not validate real-world predictive accuracy.
Model choices retain their actual provenance, allowed options and explanations. Fixed schedules and background residents are computed by code.
Report outcomes describe supported internal checks; missing or failed checks remain visible. They are not safety or fraud-prevention verdicts.
Waiting and saved 3D playback are edited for pacing. Presentation narration is separate TTS, not product Muse Voice output.
Excluded preflight recordings are not used for the final input, results, choices or verification.
